description: This file defines an Android foreground service named NodeForegroundService, responsible for managing and displaying connection status notifications related to the OpenClaw Node application. It handles starting and stopping the foreground service, updates notifications based on runtime status, and manages notification channels and actions.

classes.name: NodeForegroundService
classes.description: An Android foreground service managing notifications related to the OpenClaw Node, including establishing notification channels, updating status notifications, and handling start/stop commands.

classes.name: Quint
classes.description: A private data class used to hold five related status values obtained from the runtime for notification updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the notification channel and starts the foreground notification with basic info, then launches a coroutine to update notifications based on runtime status.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles start commands; stops the service if a stop action is received, otherwise continues to run.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels ongoing coroutines and cleans up resources when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as binding is not supported.

methods.name: ensureChannel
methods.description: Creates a notification channel for connection status notifications if it does not already exist.

methods.name: buildNotification
methods.description: Constructs and returns a notification object with specific title, text, and action buttons.

methods.name: updateNotification
methods.description: Updates the current notification with new content.

methods.name: startForegroundWithTypes
methods.description: Starts the foreground service with the specified notification, updating if already started.
